description: Listed Building Consent in connection with the replacement of existing modern sash windows with new slimline double-glazed sash windows; retrofitting of original timber sash windows with double glazing and applying of a new finish to the main entrance steps; installation of a new roof and rooflight to the existing rear closet wing; enlargement of the existing later roof extension window and addition of a new rooflight; reinstatement of missing historic mouldings and architectural details across all levels with associated internal layout alterations and refurbishment; and installation of new internal secondary glazing.
decision_conditions:
3 YEAR CONSENT PERIOD FOR LBC and CAC: The works hereby permitted shall be begun not later than three years from the date of this consent.

REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 18(1)(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: Note: The proposed development is identical in every respect to that approved under P2025/2819/LBC and P2025/2818/FUL, and the sole purpose of this application is to attach the conditions that were agreed between the parties after the decision notice was issued.
